integrity: Symbolic matrix and Taylor identities checked with the included standalone code; analytic global proof provided; no independent validation claimed.
limitations: Uniqueness is proved only for sufficiently high observation variance; no explicit threshold or generalization to unequal/correlated noise. Closely related 2003 full article and dissertation were inaccessible, leaving bibliographic priority risk.
title: Strict noncollocation and a sharp high-noise boundary layer for two Brownian path sensors
